risk_flags.description: The contract promises a specific micro-optimization but does not commit to measuring whether the report command is actually faster. Existing tests passing would not satisfy the requester’s performance goal by itself.
risk_flags.span: All existing pytest tests continue to pass (exit 0) after the change

risk_flags.description: The contract rules out broader investigation even though the actual source of sluggishness may be somewhere else in the report pipeline. This could produce a correct but ineffective change.
risk_flags.span: No algorithmic restructuring of the report pipeline beyond the hot-path date comparison fix

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the agent may make one assumed hot-path change without proving it improves the sluggish report command.
